{"metadata":{"description":"PDF parsing toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, pdf_render_page with hybrid pdfjs/built-in engines and system-font rendering for non-embedded CJK PDFs.","id":"gh:1335666184","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-pdf","slug":"zhtx2024/dsh-pdf","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","pdf","pdfjs","schematic"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"PDF parsing toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, pdf_render_page with hybrid pd"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"fjs/built-in engines and system-font rendering for non-embedded CJK PDFs."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @zhtx2026/dsh-pdf"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> PDF parsing toolkit for DeepSeek Harness — three agent-facing tools (`pdf_info` / `pdf_extract_tex"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"t` / `pdf_render_page`) with hybrid engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embed"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ded CJK fonts (e.g. EasyEDA / JLC EDA schematic exports)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Tags:** `dsh-plugin` · `pdf` · `pdfjs` · `canvas` · `schematic` · `tools`"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Or from a local checkout during development:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Then restart DSH (or open a new session) — the three tools and an agent guidance block become availa"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" restart DSH (or open a new session) — the three tools and an agent guidance block become available."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `pdf_info` | Page count, page sizes (pt), document metadata, and the font list with per-font `embe"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"dded` flags. |
| `pdf_extract_text` | Extracts text per page; optional `page` and `withPosition` (pe"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"r-line x/y coordinates + font size). |
| `pdf_render_page` | Renders one page to a PNG (local file) "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"with configurable `scale`/`outDir`; engine auto-selection. |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Why a custom renderer?"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"pdfjs-dist cannot render text in PDFs whose fonts are not embedded and lack a
`ToUnicode` map — the "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"classic case is **JLC EDA / EasyEDA schematic exports**
(SimSun/SimHei `Type0` fonts with `UniGB-UCS"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"2-H` encoding): pdfjs emits
`translateFont failed` and drops the glyphs."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"dsh-pdf solves this with a two-engine design:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **pdfjs engine** — used when *all* fonts are embedded (standard PDFs).
- **sysfont engine** — a bu"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ilt-in content-stream renderer that decodes the
PDF text operators (`BT/ET`, `Tf`, `Tm`, `Td`, `Tj`,"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" `TJ`) itself, maps
`UniGB-UCS2-H`/UTF-16BE strings to Unicode, and draws them with **system
fonts**"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" (`SimSun`, `SimHei`, `Microsoft YaHei`, …) via `@napi-rs/canvas`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Text extraction uses the same auto-selection: embedded fonts → pdfjs
text layer; non-embedded fonts "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"→ the built-in decoder (which correctly
recovers CJK text pdfjs loses)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Example"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- `lib/index.js` — cordis plugin entry (`name`, `inject`, `apply`); registers
the three tools as nat"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ive tool objects (plain JSON-Schema `parameters` and
`output` — no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` dependen"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"cy needed) and injects the
agent guidance block (`systemPrompt.section`, order 160).
- `lib/pdf-core"},{"id":"p22s4","text":".js` — self-contained engine: PDF object parser, font scanner,
pdfjs loading with fs-based `CMapRead"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"erFactory`/`StandardFontDataFactory`
(Node 24's global `fetch` doesn't speak `file://`), the built-i"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"n text
extractor, and the sysfont renderer.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the `dsh.bundle.patch` insert row"},{"id":"p22s7","text":" text
extractor, and the sysfont renderer.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the `dsh.bundle.patch` insert row."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Scanned/image-only PDFs have no text layer — extraction returns nothing
(rendering still works, as"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" a plain image).
- The sysfont renderer assumes `Type0` CID codes equal Unicode code points
(true fo"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"r `UniGB-UCS2-H` exports); exotic CID fonts fall back to pdfjs.
- Large PDFs are parsed fully into m"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"GB-UCS2-H` exports); exotic CID fonts fall back to pdfjs.
- Large PDFs are parsed fully into memory."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
